title: Cuma Bisa Tukar
subject: a man in Bandung trying to return a batik shirt two sizes too small for a refund, while the shop clerk keeps pointing at the sign saying exchange only and offering him every other shirt in the store
caption: Sundanese jaipong pop with modern band backing. Fast interlocking jaipong kendang patterns with sharp slaps, a whining rebab melody, saron metallophone ostinato, crisp kecrek clatter, driving electric bass, short keyboard brass stabs. Punchy bright mix with the kendang upfront. Male tenor with a cheeky bright delivery, female backing shouts answering the hook. 128 BPM, D minor. Comic, bouncy, cheeky. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no koplo four-on-floor, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - kendang and rebab]

[Verse 1]
Batik biru dari Pasar Baru
Di rumah nggak muat di bahu
Kancingnya mau lepas semua
Aku balik bawa struknya

[Pre-Chorus]
Teteh kasir senyum manis
Tangannya tunjuk tulisan

[Chorus]
Cuma bisa tukar, A
Uang nggak bisa kembali
Cuma bisa tukar, A
Coba yang ini sekali

[Verse 2]
Yang hijau, kebesaran
Yang merah, motif ayam
Yang ungu ada payetnya
Satu toko sudah kucoba

[Bridge - kendang break]
Akhirnya kupilih sarung
Teteh kasir tepuk tangan

[Chorus]
Cuma bisa tukar, A
Ya sudah, aku pasrah
Cuma bisa tukar, A
Sarung baru, aku pulang

[Outro - kendang and saron fade]
